courses.title: Character Head Block-out
courses.objective: Block out a stylised head from a sphere cage: brow, eyes, nose, mouth, ears, jaw and neck, using symmetry and a final proportion pass.

steps.title: Start from a sphere cage
steps.learn: A sphere cage with four faces per side gives enough resolution for facial features.
instructions: Set the base height so the head is centred.
steps.why: Block-outs start with the simplest closed form and add detail only where it is needed.

checkpoint.expected: A smooth ball with a 96-face cage.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Brow ridge
steps.learn: Select the row of faces above the eyes and extrude them outward.
instructions: Edit cage: select the forehead faces across the front.
steps.why: The brow is the first landmark of a face; it sets the eye line.

checkpoint.expected: A smooth ridge across the forehead.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Eye socket
steps.learn: Work on one side only: inset one face, then push it inward.
instructions: Select the face at the right eye position.
steps.why: Inset first keeps a rim of faces around the socket, so the shape stays crisp.

checkpoint.expected: A recess on the right side of the face.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Nose
steps.learn: Extrude the centre faces forward, then narrow them.
instructions: Extrude 9 mm, then Scale X 0.55, Z 0.8.
steps.why: A nose is a narrow wedge: pull it out first, then shape it.

checkpoint.expected: A nose that stands out from the face.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Mouth groove
steps.learn: A shallow inset-and-sink gives the line of the mouth.
instructions: Select the faces across the lower front.
steps.why: A mouth only needs a groove at block-out stage.

checkpoint.expected: A horizontal groove below the nose.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Ear
steps.learn: Again on one side: inset, pull out, flatten.
instructions: Select the four faces on the right side of the head.
steps.why: Ears are flat shells that stand off the head; extrude then squash.

checkpoint.expected: A flat ear shape on the right.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Mirror for symmetry
steps.learn: Everything so far was done on one side. Mirror copies the right half to the left.
steps.why: Symmetry halves the work and guarantees a matching face.

checkpoint.expected: Both eyes and both ears are present.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Jaw taper
steps.learn: Scale the lower faces inward to narrow the jaw.
instructions: Select all faces below the midline.
steps.why: A head is wide at the cheekbones and narrower at the jaw.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Chin
steps.learn: Pull the chin forward and down.
steps.why: A small chin move changes the character from soft to strong.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Neck
steps.learn: Extrude the bottom faces down and narrow them.
instructions: Extrude 16 mm outward (downwards), then Scale X, Y 0.75.
steps.why: A neck stub makes the head read as a head, not a ball.

checkpoint.expected: A short neck below the head.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Proportions last
steps.learn: Scale the whole cage to set the final proportions: narrower, slightly taller.
steps.why: Doing proportions last is easy, because every feature scales with the head.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Relax the cage
steps.learn: Relax evens out the cage so the surface flows smoothly.
steps.why: Small relaxation removes lumps that extrusions leave behind.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Crisp eyelids
steps.learn: Creases keep selected edges sharp after smoothing.
instructions: Select the faces around both eye sockets.
steps.why: Selective creasing gives crispness exactly where you need it.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Auto-crease the rest
steps.learn: Auto-crease marks edges sharper than an angle.
steps.why: Auto-crease catches the corners you have not marked by hand.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Convert to NURBS
steps.learn: Convert the SubD to exact NURBS surfaces for downstream CAD.
steps.why: NURBS can be exported to engineering systems; the SubD stays editable.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

courses.title: Sneaker: Sole, Tread & Upper
courses.objective: Model a sneaker from two SubD cages: a tapered upper with an ankle opening, and a sole with a tread pattern, then thicken the upper into a shell.

steps.title: Upper block
steps.learn: The upper starts as a box the size of a foot.
instructions: Base at Z 8 so the sole fits underneath.
steps.why: Block out the overall size first, then refine.

checkpoint.expected: A box that will become the upper.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Add loops
steps.learn: Loop cuts give you the faces you need to shape the toe, arch and ankle.
instructions: Loop cut across X, 1 cut, and across Z, 1 cut.
steps.why: More loops mean more control, but also more points to manage.

checkpoint.expected: The box is divided into a grid of faces.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Shape the toe
steps.learn: Scale the front faces to narrow and lower the toe box, in two passes.
instructions: Select the front 3 rows: Scale X 0.75, Z 0.6.
Select the front 1 row: Scale X 0.8.
steps.why: Two gentler passes give a smoother toe than one hard one.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Raise the heel collar
steps.learn: Move the top rear faces up.
instructions: Select the top faces at the back.
steps.why: A higher collar cups the heel.

checkpoint.expected: The back of the shoe stands taller.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Ankle opening
steps.learn: Inset the top faces behind the laces, then delete them to open the shoe.
instructions: Select the top faces from the arch to the heel.
steps.why: Inset first, so a rim of faces remains around the hole.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Hold the toe cap
steps.learn: A crease keeps the edge of the toe cap crisp.
steps.why: Creases are how a soft surface keeps a hard edge.

checkpoint.expected: A sharper line across the toe.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Relax the upper
steps.learn: Relax evens out the cage.
steps.why: Relax after shaping, never before.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Sole block
steps.learn: The sole is its own cage, a flat box slightly larger than the upper.
instructions: SubD › Box (primitive): width 46, depth 120, height 10, at Z 0.
steps.why: A separate cage lets the sole have its own topology and tread.

checkpoint.expected: A flat slab under the upper.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Loops for the tread
steps.learn: A grid of faces on the sole is the tread pattern.
steps.why: The grid size sets the size of the tread blocks.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Shape the sole outline
steps.learn: Narrow the toe and heel so the sole follows the foot.
instructions: Select the front rows: Scale X 0.8.
Select the rear rows: Scale X 0.9.
steps.why: The sole outline should be a little larger than the upper all around.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Cut the tread
steps.learn: Select all the bottom faces, inset them, then push them in to make tread blocks.
steps.why: Inset then extrude inward leaves ribs between the pockets.

checkpoint.expected: A pattern of recessed pockets on the sole.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Crisp sole edges
steps.learn: Auto-crease keeps the sole outline sharp.
steps.why: Soles are hard parts: crease their outline.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Thicken the upper
steps.learn: Give the upper a wall.
instructions: SubD+ › Thicken: 2.2 mm inward on the upper.
steps.why: A shell is what you would actually manufacture.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

courses.title: Fuselage, Canopy, Wings & Nacelles
courses.objective: Model a small aircraft from three SubD cages: a tapered fuselage with canopy and fin, a swept wing, and engine nacelles made once and mirrored.

steps.title: Fuselage cylinder
steps.learn: A 16-sided cylinder with ten rings, lying along the Y axis, is the fuselage.
instructions: SubD › Cylinder (primitive): axis Y, radius 14, height 120, 16 sides, 10 rings.
Start it at Y −60 so the nose is at the front.
steps.why: Rings along the length are where you will shape the nose and tail.

checkpoint.expected: A smooth cylinder lying along Y.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Taper the nose
steps.learn: Three scale passes with a shrinking selection give a smooth taper.
instructions: Select the front 4 rings, Scale X, Z 0.85.
steps.why: Repeating a scale on a smaller and smaller selection is how you grade a taper.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Taper and lift the tail
steps.learn: The tail narrows more sharply and sweeps upward.
steps.why: A raised tail gives the fin and tailplane room.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Canopy
steps.learn: Inset the faces on top of the cockpit, extrude them up, and shape the blister.
instructions: Select the top faces between Y −36 and 10.
steps.why: Inset-extrude is the standard way to raise a feature out of a surface.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Vertical fin
steps.learn: Extrude the top faces near the tail into a fin, then thin it.
instructions: Select the top faces at the rear.
steps.why: A fin is an extrusion that has been flattened.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Wing block
steps.learn: The wing is a second cage: a flat box.
instructions: SubD › Box (primitive): width 140, depth 28, height 3, base at Z −4, Y −4.
steps.why: Separate cages for separate parts keep the topology clean.

checkpoint.expected: A flat slab through the fuselage.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Loops along the span
steps.learn: Loop cuts give the wing the rows it needs to be swept.
instructions: SubD › Loop cut across X, 5 cuts.
SubD › Loop cut across Y, 1 cut.
steps.why: Add loops before moving geometry, not after.

checkpoint.expected: The wing has rows of faces along the span.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Sweep and taper
steps.learn: Move the outer faces back and narrow them, on both sides.
instructions: Select the outer faces on each side.
steps.why: Do both sides to keep the wing symmetrical.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Nacelle cylinder
steps.learn: Build one engine nacelle under the right wing.
instructions: SubD › Cylinder (primitive): axis Y, radius 6, height 34, 12 sides, 5 rings.
steps.why: Build one, then mirror it.

checkpoint.expected: A small cylinder under the right wing.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Intake and exhaust
steps.learn: Recess the front cap for an intake and narrow the rear.
instructions: Select the front cap: Inset 0.35, Extrude −3.
steps.why: Inset then extrude inward is also how you make holes and pockets.

checkpoint.expected: An intake at the front and a narrowed exhaust.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Mirror the nacelle
steps.learn: Mirror at X = 0 to make the left nacelle.
instructions: SubD › Mirror, axis X, at 0, on the nacelle.
steps.why: Mirror keeps two parts perfectly identical.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Smooth all three
steps.learn: Relax each cage a little so the surfaces flow.
instructions: Relax 1 iteration, factor 0.3 on the fuselage, wing and nacelles.
steps.why: A single light relax pass is enough.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Crisp edges
steps.learn: Auto-crease keeps the wing edges sharp and the fin edge crisp.
steps.why: Thin trailing edges need creases or they round off.

checkpoint.expected: A crisp wing, a smooth fuselage.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

courses.title: Faucet with Bent Spout
courses.objective: Model a kitchen faucet from one cylinder cage: flared base, tapered neck, a spout bent by repeated rotate-and-extrude, a lever and an aerator tip.

steps.title: Body cylinder
steps.learn: A 12-sided cylinder cage with six rings is the whole faucet’s starting point.
instructions: SubD › Cylinder (primitive): axis Z, radius 16, height 70, 12 sides, 6 rings.
steps.why: Pick the side count by the smoothness you need; 12 is a good block-out.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Flare the base
steps.learn: Scale the lowest faces outward to make a mounting flange.
steps.why: A wider foot shows where the faucet is fixed to the sink.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Taper the neck
steps.learn: Scale the upper faces inward.
steps.why: A tapered neck is where the spout starts.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Start the spout
steps.learn: Extrude the top cap straight up.
steps.why: The spout begins as a straight tube.

checkpoint.expected: A straight tube above the body.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Bend and extend 1
steps.learn: Rotate the end cap, then extrude along its new direction. Repeating this walks the spout around an arch.
instructions: Select the end cap of the spout.
SubD › Rotate 40° about X, then SubD › Extrude 22 mm.
steps.why: Rotate-then-extrude is the classic way to model a pipe, hose or gooseneck in SubD.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Bend and extend 2
steps.learn: The same two operations again.
instructions: Select the end cap of the spout.
SubD › Rotate 40° about X, then SubD › Extrude 22 mm.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Bend and extend 3
steps.learn: The same two operations again.
instructions: Select the end cap of the spout.
SubD › Rotate 40° about X, then SubD › Extrude 20 mm.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Bend and extend 4
steps.learn: The same two operations again.
instructions: Select the end cap of the spout.
SubD › Rotate 30° about X, then SubD › Extrude 18 mm.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Aerator tip
steps.learn: Inset the tip cap and push it in slightly to form the aerator ring.
steps.why: Small details at the tip make a spout read as a spout.

checkpoint.expected: A ring and a recess at the spout tip.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Lever handle
steps.learn: Extrude the side faces outward to make a handle, then flatten it.
instructions: Select the faces on the right side near the top.
steps.why: Pull out first, then shape.

checkpoint.expected: A flat lever on the right.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Relax and crease
steps.learn: Relax smooths the cage; auto-crease keeps the base edge crisp.
steps.why: Relax first, crease second.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Make it a shell
steps.learn: Thicken the SubD into a hollow wall of constant thickness.
steps.why: A thickened shell is lighter and ready for moulding.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".
